profile: Acquisition sources for Bureaucrat representative weapons (AOBuddy10)
method: Representative ids are taken from bureaucrat-weapons.json (usableWeaponTypes[].representativeWeapons).

how/where/steps/efs are JOINED from bureaucrat-weapons-endgame.json, where each endgame model carries an acquisition resolved from the cited ao-universe.com / wiki.aodb.us guides listed in that file's _sources. Match is by item id, else by model name (representative ids can be a lower QL of the same model).
expansion is read from the weapon's own ToWield Expansion(389) BitAnd criterion in items.ocp, mapped via AOSharp.Common ExpansionFlags - authoritative client data.
Anything with no cited acquisition is written how='unknown' with no where/steps. No vendor, mob or mission is guessed.

steps: Drops from The Beast, the final boss of the Pandemonium raid (Shadowlands). 'Lord of X' is QL 300 and 'Lady of X' QL 299; the two are otherwise identical items. The Beast has a 9-hour respawn; loot pooled over 104 documented kills shows 2-4 weapons, 4 armour pieces, both hilts, 1-2 profession stars and one Shadowbreed per kill. No individual weapon drop rate is published.
244742.notes: Acquisition joined from bureaucrat-weapons-endgame.json (model 'Lord of Abandonment').

246244.name: Sword of Dawn
steps: Notum Seed + Sunrise Hilt = Sword of Dawn  (Clan/Redeemed side)
Novictum Seed + Sunset Hilt = Sword of Dusk  (Omni/Unredeemed side)
Requires 500 Weapon Smithing - the only step in the whole Xan line with a real skill requirement.

Notum Seed drops from The Night Heart on the Redeemed (Clan) side of Pandemonium; Novictum Seed from The Night Heart on the Unredeemed (Omni) side. Neither is a 100% drop; both also turn up in player shops.
Sunrise Hilt (Clan) and Sunset Hilt (Omni) are 100% NODROP drops from The Beast. Recorded rates over 104 kills: Sunrise 18.27%, Sunset 4.81%.
Neutrals capped at 25,000 faction cannot obtain these.
246244.notes: Acquisition joined from bureaucrat-weapons-endgame.json (model 'Sword of Dawn').

254625.name: Kyr'Ozch Pistol - Type 1
254625.where: Alien city raids / Alien Mothership (base weapon + clump)
steps: Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n> + untyped Kyr'Ozch weapon = the typed weapon. The type decides which special attacks the weapon gets.
Make the typed clump first: Kyr'Ozch Structural Analyzer + Solid Clump of Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material = Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type <n>.

The Structural Analyzer is either Field Quantum Physics All-Purpose Tool (reusable) + Kyr'Ozch Atomic Re-Structuralizing Tool (consumed; a common Hacker'Uri drop) at 600 Quantum FT, or the reward for Uncle Bazzit's AI Perk 3 quest.

Typing needs 6x the weapon's QL in Mechanical Engineering and 6x QL in Weapon Smithing, and the clump must be at least 90% of the weapon's QL. Typing is PERMANENT - a weapon cannot be re-typed or cleared.

Solid Clumps and the untyped weapons drop from the alien city-raid boss (the General) and from the boss on the alien Mothership. Alien City Raid needs the AI expansion, an org city and a fully charged city controller with a CRU; documented raid bosses are Ankari, Cha, Illari, Jaxx, Rimah and Xoch. No drop rates are published.

Type -> specials: 1 Fling Shot; 2 Aimed Shot; 3 Fling+Aimed; 4 Burst; 5 Fling+Burst; 12 Burst+Full Auto; 13 Fling+Burst+Full Auto; 48 Brawl+Dimach; 76 Brawl+Fast Attack; 112 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack; 240 Brawl+Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack; 880 Dimach+Fast Attack+Parry+Riposte; 992 Dimach+Fast Attack+Sneak Attack+Parry+Riposte.
254625.notes: Wielding requires expansion 'AlienInvasion' (ToWield Expansion stat 389, items.ocp). Acquisition joined from bureaucrat-weapons-endgame.json (model 'Kyr'Ozch Pistol - Type 1').

264884.name: Ofab Silverback Mk 4
264884.where: Battlestation - Ofab terminals, Unicorn Defence Hub
steps: Bought as Mk 1 with Victory Points at the Ofab weapon terminals in the Unicorn Defence Hub (the 'Ofab Shop') in the Battle Station central area. VP is earned on Battlestations and on Lost Eden (Alien Mothership) missions. Terminals are bracketed by level: 10-30, 31-60, 61-100, 101-150, 151-200, 201-214, 215-220.

Upgraded Mk 1 -> Mk 6 (five upgrades, strictly sequential) by adding a Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material clump to the weapon. No tradeskill skill is required; the clump must be at least 80% of the weapon's QL. Each upgrade also changes the weapon's appearance.

Bio-Material by weapon: Type 34 for Ofab Panther (1h Blunt) and Ofab Bear (2h Blunt); Type 18 for Ofab Mongoose (1h Edged), Ofab Wolf (2h Edged) and Ofab Viper (Piercing); Type 812 for Ofab Peregrine (Pistol), Ofab Hawk (SMG) and Ofab Tiger (Bow); Type 687 for Ofab Cobra (Rifle), Ofab Shark (Assault Rifle) and Ofab Silverback (Shotgun).

The clumps drop from the bosses in Lost Eden Alien Mothership missions (taken from the Unicorn Recruiter at the Unicorn Outpost in the Outerzones, via ICC) and from the Dreadloch bosses at the Clan and Omni camps.
No VP price list is published; the only figure found is a player report of 1100 VP for a QL75 Ofab Pistol.
264884.notes: Wielding requires expansion 'LostEden' (ToWield Expansion stat 389, items.ocp). Acquisition joined from bureaucrat-weapons-endgame.json (model 'Ofab Silverback Mk 4').

267125.name: Dreadloch Thrasher
steps: Dreadloch weapons are a DIRECT DROP from the Dreadloch camp bosses, not a tradeskill. They are QL300 only and require the Lost Eden expansion to wield (from the item's own Expansion(389) criterion).

There are two sets of five camps, one per side. Omni-side camps (the CLAN quest chain, started by Captain Cante Hawke in Old Athens): Clondyke - Force Recon Commander 191; Eastern Foul Plains - Special Agent Moxy; Pleasant Meadows - Major Woon; Southern Artery Valley - Assault Commander Pax; Upper Stret East Bank - Peal Thunder.

Clan-side camps (the OMNI quest chain, started by Paolo Turin near the Grid terminal in Omni-1 Trade 409x542, who sends you to Sergeant Jasmine Cordell in Omni-1 Entertainment 906x629): Belial Forest 3184x503 - Brigadier Crux; Athen Shire / War Academy 1720x1920 - Assault Commander Sleek; The Longest Road / Drumdar 3650x574 - Chief Gunner Kyle Swan; Broken Shores 2240x4765 - Special Agent Deko; Upper Stret East Bank / Safe Haventown 1798.6x2207.0 - Carillion Thunder.

The bosses have a 2-hour respawn and the corpse can be looted for 29 minutes before it rots. The quest is NOT required to claim the loot - completing it adds a merit token worth +50 side tokens and +500 Victory Points.

The same bosses also drop high-quality Kyr'Ozch clumps for Ofab upgrades, Hellfyre Magma Suit armour, the merit/combat board bases and the Dreadloch utility items (Damage Amplifier, Endurance Booster, Sniper's Friend, Stab Guidance System, Survival Predictor).
No per-weapon drop rate is published on either allowed source.
267125.notes: Wielding requires expansion 'LostEden' (ToWield Expansion stat 389, items.ocp). Acquisition joined from bureaucrat-weapons-endgame.json (model 'Dreadloch Thrasher').

280717.name: Abandonment of the Xan
280717.where: Legacy of the Xan team instances (device) + Pandemonium (base weapon)
steps: Xan Weapon Upgrade Device + <base weapon QL 299/300> = <X> of the Xan. No tradeskill skill required.

The Xan Weapon Upgrade Device is QL 300, NODROP/Unique and is consumed by the combine. It drops in the three Legacy of the Xan team instances entered from floor portals in the Central Hub playfield: The Alien Threat / 'Mitaar Hero' (portal at 350 x 410, boss Technomaster Sinuh), LoX: Ground Chief Vortexx (portal at 523 x 307), and The Xan 12-man (portal at 419 x 324, final boss Deranged Xan). Since patch 18.3 none of them need the old prerequisite quests. No drop rate is published. The combine itself needs NO tradeskill skill.
Base weapon for most sins is the matching Lord/Lady of <sin> from The Beast in Pandemonium.
Dawn of the Xan and Dusk of the Xan take Sword of Dawn / Sword of Dusk instead (see those entries).
Angst of the Xan additionally accepts High Lord of Angst; Anger/Envy/Angst of the Xan additionally accept the matching Superior Rebuilt Perennium weapon.
280717.notes: Wielding requires expansion 'LegacyOfTheXan' (ToWield Expansion stat 389, items.ocp). Acquisition joined from bureaucrat-weapons-endgame.json (model 'Abandonment of the Xan').

The Beast has a 9-hour respawn; loot pooled over 104 documented kills shows 2-4 weapons, 4 armour pieces, both hilts, 1-2 profession stars and one Shadowbreed per kill. No individual weapon drop rate is published.
294001.notes: Acquisition joined from bureaucrat-weapons-endgame.json (model 'Lady of Wisdom').

302941.name: Corrupted Lord of Greed
302941.where: Pyramid of Home / "Dark Pyramid Below" (6-man, level 201-220)
steps: A DIRECT DROP - not a tradeskill step above 'X of the Xan'. The Corrupted weapons are a parallel endgame drop line, added in patch 18.8.6 (27 Oct 2015).
They drop from the bosses of Pyramid of Home, a 6-man level 201-220 dungeon: Cybernetic Daemon, Azdaja the Joyous, Maiden, then Phobettor. Portals last 4 hours (18.8.7).
Entrance: the giant crater north of the city of Home on Rubi-Ka; since 18.8.6 you enter through the large door behind Number Nine inside the Temple of Home, Broken Shores.

Access needs ONE of: any Profession Nanodeck worn (Dust Brigade quest base version or the Xan-upgraded one), the quest 'Guarding the Source' completed, or the Legacy of the Xan quests completed. The guide reports it also worked with just a Beast profession star worn.

Patch 18.8.8 (9 Nov 2015) confirms what these are: the duplicate 'Chaos of the Xan' entry was renamed and modified into the Corrupted Lord of Chaos, and the Achaean Conqueror was added to drop alongside the other Corrupted weapons. That is why the client data shows them as QL 300 Legacy-of-the-Xan-gated weapons with the same flavour text as the 'X of the Xan' items but different damage and a title level 7 (level 205+) gate instead of title level 6.
The Wisdom versions come in Atrox and non-Atrox and right/left-hand variants, adjusted with a screwdriver to match breed.
No per-boss drop rates are published.
302941.notes: Wielding requires expansion 'LegacyOfTheXan' (ToWield Expansion stat 389, items.ocp). Acquisition joined from bureaucrat-weapons-endgame.json (model 'Corrupted Lord of Greed').

_sources.inheritedFrom: bureaucrat-weapons-endgame.json (_sources there lists every ao-universe.com / wiki.aodb.us URL behind the acquisition text reproduced here)
_sources.honestFlag: 'unknown' means no drop mob, vendor or mission could be verified on an allowed source. auno.org (anti-bot 403), aoitems.com (parked) and anarchyonline.fandom.com (402) are blocked to automation, and the playbook forbids recording fuzzy secondhand claims from them.
_sources.toImprove: Extend the acquisition table in tools/mp-weapon-extractor/gen-weapons-endgame.ps1 ($acq) with further cited weapon lines; every model whose name matches gains a source here automatically.

_unverified: 43 of the 68 representative ids carry a cited acquisition, joined by model name and id from bureaucrat-weapons-endgame.json, which cites ao-universe.com and wiki.aodb.us. 25 say 'unknown'.

'unknown' means no acquisition is documented on the two allowed sources. The per-item drop databases (auno.org, aoitems.com) are blocked to automation, so no drop mob or playfield is approximated - 6 of those 25 at least carry an expansion gate read from the item itself, which narrows where they can come from without naming it.
_deviations: 63% cited coverage (43 of 68) on a set that is mostly Pistol. The Pistol lines a Crat actually wants - Xan (Lust of the Xan), Ofab, Kyr'Ozch, Dreadloch and the Crat-locked Motivator / Education / Revoked pistols - are the well-documented ones, so the covered fraction is concentrated exactly where a player looks, while the unknowns are mostly generic Rubi-Ka models.
Unlike the Soldier file, no source here is a shop. Nothing in the Bureaucrat's endgame pistol list is vendor-bought on either allowed source, so 'shop' never appears as a how.
